source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. setting up part of BIOS setting and save.
2. Check time in BIOS page.
3. AC system and plug out Cmos, after 3~5 min plug in
4. Check BIOS setting and time.

Ceritiria:

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Human opens chassis and uses CMOS jumper/battery.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Operator confirms CMOS clear and repost.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO; correctly identifies physical/destructive reset but omits source wait, RTC behavior, board method and recovery details.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED; adds saved settings, board-specific clear method, 3–5-minute interval, RTC/POST evidence, ESD/AC isolation and restoration ownership.

original_test_intent: Save known non-default BIOS state and RTC time, physically remove system power and CMOS retention for 3–5 minutes, then verify BIOS defaults, RTC behavior and successful POST/boot.
original_method: An operator records firmware configuration/time, follows the exact board service procedure to isolate AC and remove/clear CMOS retention, waits the source interval, restores hardware and visually records BIOS defaults/time; automation collects pre/post platform health.
manual_activity: AC isolation, chassis access, CMOS battery/jumper manipulation and BIOS-page observation are the defining operations. The agent can only assist with records/logs, so MANUAL ONLY applies independently of the Seq 182 case-specific decision.
required_inputs: Board/service-manual CMOS jumper or battery procedure
Approved non-default settings to seed and expected post-clear defaults
Expected RTC/date/time result and acceptable tolerance
Qualified operator, ESD tools, AC isolation and 3–5-minute timing
Saved boot/storage/security/fan settings, OOB and no-POST recovery
safety_requirements: Record all critical firmware settings and boot/storage state before reset.
Only a qualified operator disconnects AC and touches the documented jumper/battery under ESD control.
Do not short unidentified pins or work while standby power remains.
Expect boot/security/storage changes; verify recovery before the destructive reset.
No automatic repeated clear, reboot or settings restoration after failure.
agent_execution_scope: Create the pre/post setting/default/time comparison matrix and archive baseline logs.
Guide the approved sequence/timer without claiming physical work.
Collect POST, BIOS-version, BMC/SEL and OS/boot/storage evidence after operator completion.
Report Tool Result without BIOS visual or verdict claims.
engineer_actions: Approve the destructive reset and board procedure.
Physically isolate power, clear CMOS for 3–5 minutes and restore hardware.
Inspect BIOS defaults/time, authorize setting restoration and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Conceptually correct but generic: it introduces jumper shorting as an alternative not selected by the source and omits 3–5 minutes, RTC and BIOS evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the board-approved physical method; automation is limited to evidence comparison and post-health collection.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Seed/save settings, BIOS time, AC/CMOS removal, 3–5-minute interval, default criterion and 10/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed pre-state export/photo set, timed operator checklist and structured post-default/RTC/boot comparison, with separate restoration authorization.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board revision and BIOS/BMC versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Board service manual and BIOS default/RTC specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds traceability and recovery without replacing physical reset.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Board method, defaults and RTC expectation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Remote software cannot prove standby power removal or correct battery/jumper manipulation.

project_override_considerations: The project may select the board-documented jumper or battery method and critical settings to restore. Claims must name that method and actual wait interval.
expected_evidence: Pre-reset BIOS settings/time/photos, boot/storage/security state and approval
Operator AC isolation/CMOS method/timed 3–5-minute service record
Post-reset BIOS default/time photos and successful POST
BMC/SEL/OS/boot/storage health, restoration record, Tool Result and verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The procedure and criterion coherently target CMOS reset to defaults. Exact physical method and RTC expectation are missing project/platform inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intent is clear and manually executable once the board method and recovery plan are supplied.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps manual/destructive conclusion but restores source-specific timing, RTC and BIOS evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with MANUAL ONLY and retains its safety/recovery model.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Clarifies that ED-32 is not generalized; this row is manual because of its own physical core.

review_improvement: Prevents generic jumper advice, preserves configuration provenance and separates reset evidence from later settings restoration.
independent_technical_reasoning: The outcome depends on physically removing CMOS retention and visually inspecting firmware defaults. These cannot be established through remote commands, so manual-only classification is required.

source_provenance.history: Exact-code repository search; ED-32 reviewed as non-applicable case-specific precedent

no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat CMOS clear, reboot loops or restore settings automatically after no-POST or unexpected defaults. Preserve state and await the owner.
